content: आचार्यः [आ-चर्-ण्यत् <ls>P. III. 1. 100. Vārt. Kāśi.</ls>] .²1 A teacher or preceptor (in general). .²2 A spiritual guide or preceptor, holy teacher (one who invests a boy with the sacred thread, instructs him in the Vedas <ab>&c.</ab>); उपनीय तु यः शिष्यम् वेदमध्यापयेद् द्विजः . सकल्पं सरहस्यं च तमाचार्यं प्रचक्षते <ls>Ms. 2. 140</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> also आचिनोति च शास्त्रार्थम् आचारे स्थापयत्यपि . स्वयमाचरते यस्तु स आचार्य इति स्मृतः .. read also वेदाध्यापनेन च आचार्यो भवति <ls>Ms. 6. 1. 35</ls>; see अध्यापक also. .²3 One who propounds a particular doctrine. .²4 (When affixed to proper names) Learned, venerable (somewhat like the <lang>English</lang> <ab>Dr.</ab>). .²5 An adviser or preceptor at a sacrifice <ab>&c.</ab> .²6 An epithet of Droṇa; आचार्यमुपसंगम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत् <ls>Bg. 1. 2</ls>. .²7 A degree or title of proficiency. .{@-र्या@} A female preceptor, a spiritual preceptress.
